what: 2. The Problem: Total-Indirect-Effect Tests Have a Blind Spot
title: Power Enhancement for High-Dimensional Mediation: A Guided Tour
text: many mediators, conventional approach summarizes total indirect effect, written beta: sum mediators one’s individual indirect effect. global test checks whether beta = 0. works well mediators push outcome way. consider two active mediators whose individual indirect effects equal size opposite sign: say +0.5 M_1 -0.5 M_2. mediators genuinely active, yet contributions cancel, total indirect effect test built beta sees zero concludes “mediation,” even though two mediators plainly active. rare edge case: whenever different pathways move outcome opposite directions (heterogeneous mediation, extreme contrasting mediation), total indirect effect understates truth test loses power. article calls core limitation existing high-dimensional mediation tests.
